characters.name: Twin tails
characters.hair: Two high angular ponytails that sweep out horizontally then bend downward; short broken fringe with a wide central notch. Muted charcoal-teal hair, two large shadow shapes.
characters.expression: Incredulous confrontation: one brow sharply lifted, the other low; one wide eye and one compressed eye; large open slanted black mouth with thin top tooth bar.

characters.name: Twin buns
characters.hair: Two compact high rounded hair buns, broad side-swept fringe exposing both eyes, short nape. Muted plum-black hair.
characters.expression: Explosive disbelief: both brows lifted with pinched inner ends; eyes wide but not huge; open irregular rectangular mouth, black cavity and one ivory tooth strip.

characters.name: Crown braid
characters.hair: One thick braid loops around the crown like integrated hair, with six simple interlocking broad segments; two tiny front wisps, hair otherwise tucked back. Deep brown hair.
characters.expression: Tense suspicion: brows pull inward unevenly, narrowed upper eyelids but visible white eye shapes; mouth pulled open diagonally as if interrupting a claim.

characters.name: Sculpted roll
characters.hair: Tall sculpted pompadour ending in one forward hooked roll above the forehead, tightly tapered sides and exposed ears; large smooth masses, no many spikes. Muted burgundy-black hair.
characters.expression: A startled challenge: one eyebrow raised high, the other almost straight; direct black pupils; open crooked wedge mouth with visible thin tooth plane.

characters.name: Round curls
characters.hair: Compact rounded cloud of tight curls rendered as only eight broad scalloped masses, two simple curls over the forehead; warm chestnut hair.
characters.expression: Agitated uncertainty: brows steeply arched and pinched at bridge, one eyelid lifted further than the other, broad open mouth wider than tall.

characters.name: Hime fringe
characters.hair: Long straight hime silhouette ending just beside the collar, blunt eyebrow-length fringe with a small central break, two short square cheek-level side panels and longer outer panels. Muted blue-black hair.
characters.expression: Frozen alarm: eyes widen while brows draw together, mouth a sharp open trapezoid with black interior and a narrow upper tooth strip.

characters.name: Folded topknot
characters.hair: A single high folded oval topknot with one broad short tail swept backward, very short temple hair, two angular forelocks separated by a wide center gap. Muted dark olive hair. Do not copy the approved fan ponytail.
characters.expression: Restrained outrage: one brow down and one lifted, upper lids pressing the black pupils, mouth open sideways with a clenched top tooth plane.

characters.name: Twin braids
characters.hair: Two thick straight braids descending beside the cheeks to collar level, each only four broad graphic braid segments, parted front hair pulled away from the forehead. Muted brick-brown hair.
characters.expression: Shocked doubt: inner brows raised then kinked down, one eye wider, asymmetric open mouth pulled toward one cheek, large black interior.

characters.name: V forelock
characters.hair: Very short sides with a single broad V-shaped forelock centered above the nose and two smooth diagonal hair planes rising at the crown; deep graphite hair. No spiky crop or bowl cut.
characters.expression: Sharp incredulity: one brow hooked high, the other pressed down; pupils look straight at viewer; mouth stretched open into a small angular shout.

characters.name: Hook quiff
characters.hair: One large S-shaped quiff curls upward and sideways above the crown, with short smooth sides and one small angled forelock; smoky copper hair, no ponytail or topknot.
characters.expression: A moment of recoiling disbelief without turning the head: wide eyes, raised uneven brows and an asymmetric open mouth with a thin visible tooth edge.

characters.name: Low side tail
characters.hair: Hair parted strongly to one side and gathered into one low short side ponytail visible next to the right ear; one broad fringe swoop, clean opposite temple. Muted dusty-purple hair.
characters.expression: An angry question: one eye compressed into a sharp white wedge, other eye widened, brows bent inward, mouth a broad tilted black opening.

characters.name: Broad locks
characters.hair: Five thick rope-like hair locks sweep back from the forehead, two locks hanging beside the ears and ending above collar; large simple solid shapes with no individual strands. Near-black brown hair.
characters.expression: Alarm interrupted by skepticism: one inner brow raised and other drawn down; eyes direct; open offset mouth with a straight thin ivory tooth plane.

characters.name: Geometric rows
characters.hair: Five broad geometric cornrow braid bands go from forehead toward the back, joined in a small low upright tuft; no fine braid texture, exposed temples and forehead. Deep espresso hair.
characters.expression: Confrontational surprise: brows sharply asymmetric, wide black oval pupils inside compressed white eye shapes, mouth open as an off-center trapezoid.

characters.name: Flipped wings
characters.hair: Medium hair ending beside the jaw in two large outward-upward flipped wing tips, smooth middle part with short parted curtain fringe; muted ash-rose hair. No waves and no asymmetrical bob.
characters.expression: A tense startled protest: one lifted brow and one frowning brow, eyes wide, large open mouth with a sharp corner and one dark red interior plane.

characters.name: Rear tail crest
characters.hair: Compact high triangular crest with short clean sides, two tiny temple points, and one slim low nape tail curving beside the left neck to collar height. Muted navy hair.
characters.expression: Disbelief with gritted energy: brows squeezed at the bridge, one eye more open, mouth an angular half-open slit showing a broad ivory tooth band above a black wedge.

characters.name: Halo curls
characters.hair: Rounded halo of hair with ten large scalloped outer lobes and no strand texture, modest compact volume around crown and temples; deep charcoal-violet hair. Keep face and neck exactly normal proportions.
characters.expression: Wide-eyed alarm mixed with doubt: one eyebrow raised more, other pinched inward, large open mouth pulled slightly to one side.

characters.name: Braided knot
characters.hair: Two large flat braids sweep from the temples upward and meet in a small square braided knot on the crown, with a short blunt separated fringe, broad clean hair shapes; muted dark teal hair.
characters.expression: Defiant uncertainty: one low slanted brow and one high flat brow, direct black pupils, open asymmetrical wedge mouth with slightly clenched upper teeth.

characters.name: Temple spirals
characters.hair: Short smooth cap of hair with one oversized simple spiral curl at each temple, forehead exposed except for one short curled center lock; muted auburn hair. No bun or bob silhouette.
characters.expression: An exaggerated puzzled objection: brows lift and pinch in opposition, one eye wider and one narrowed, open mouth as a tilted rectangular wedge.

characters.name: Winged mullet
characters.hair: Short pointed micro-fringe with a wide central break, two wide flat side locks flare outward behind the ears, and a narrow short shaggy nape tail. Muted dark grey-green hair; five broad locks only.
characters.expression: Fierce surprise: brows slant strongly inward with one inner tip high, one eye wide, mouth open in a broad sharp-edged shout with one thin tooth plane.

characters.name: Low double knots
characters.hair: Two low compact hair knots positioned just behind and below both ears, with a clean zigzag part and a short swept forelock; dusty warm brown hair, no high buns or high ponytails.
characters.expression: Doubt at the edge of alarm: one brow sharply raised, the other presses the eye into a white wedge; mouth open diagonally with a dark red lower interior and thin top teeth.

feedback: Hairstyles too strange; use normal anime hairstyles.
Include men and women, different expressions, collar/clothing, colored eyes, goggles, earrings, bandages and light injuries.
